title: Controlled GMGN wallet stats full 1,433-address live rerun after parser and transport recovery
objective: Execute one manually triggered, read-only, Solana-only, GMGN-official-API rerun for exactly 1,433 hash-verified valid unique wallets. Query only 7d and 30d stats in batches of at most 20 wallets, with at most 72 CLI invocations per period and 144 total, strictly serial with at least 1,000ms between adjacent invocations. Persist only allowlisted normalized unverified GMGN fields and irreversible fingerprints to a new external output directory. Fail closed before network on input hash or selection mismatch, PARK on absent API key, and require a separate zero-network independent audit before completion.
forbidden_actions: Do not call Helius, Chain.fm APIs, Dune, RPC, browser automation, web scraping, GMGN web pages, third-party providers, or fallback.
Do not use any chain other than Solana and do not enable BSC, Robinhood, cron, background loops, auto-discovery, ranking, or automatic daily updates.
Do not exceed 144 GMGN CLI invocations or the 144 physical-provider-request upper bound. Do not retry, paginate, auto-fill, or use concurrency.
Do not query signed holdings or read, display, persist, or forward GMGN_PRIVATE_KEY. Stats authentication is API-key-only and key presence may be recorded only as a Boolean.

Do not print, persist, or commit plaintext wallet addresses, labels, credentials, proxy URLs, credential URLs, raw provider payloads, raw stdout/stderr, token identifiers, transaction identifiers, counterparties, or complete exceptions.
Do not write databases, Redis, caches, queues, or production systems.
Do not overwrite or reinterpret historical 100-wallet or 1,433-wallet outputs.
Do not label GMGN data as chain-confirmed, verified profitability, wallet quality, UR/N/P grades, or LLM conclusions.
